acceptance: A small launcher here, beside the wrapper: pick from active-projects with fzf, then `zmx attach <project>.<n>` from that directory, with the next free n. Dots in the project name fold to `_`, as zp does. Labels and the scope stay the wrapper's. README's integrations section describes it. Its name is the operator's to choose.
name: zx
notes: 2026-11-06: operator named it zx, and chose a zsh function over a packaged script, since active-projects is one: ~/.config/zsh/functions.zsh, tested by tests/zx.zsh there. That replaces this task's `here, beside the wrapper`. Against real zmx, two runs made zmux.1 and zmux.2 with project and id labels and the picked directory as cwd.
title: Start a session in an active project
